intended_message: We need to lock the build and only fix bugs until launch, no new features.

turns.speaker: wearer
turns.text: So for the next two weeks, we freeze features and just kill bugs before launch, right?

turns.speaker: counterpart
turns.text: Yeah, makes sense. So should we still squeeze in that new onboarding step?

turns.speaker: wearer
turns.text: Well no, that counts as a feature, so that would have to wait.

turns.speaker: counterpart
turns.text: Oh got it, I thought freeze just meant no big stuff.
